title: Fringe Show 2: The Greatest Musical the World has Ever Seen ⭐️⭐️ @Edi...
transcript: The greatest musical the world has ever seen is a show that unfortunately, but expectedly, does not live up to its name. But it's also not the worst musical I've ever seen. This is a one man musical all about this man who has an undisclosed social anxiety disorder. Similar to A Dear Evan Hansen, only instead of writing letters to himself, he sides to write a musical. And the title itself is, like, intentionally misleading, right? Because he puts so much pressure on himself to make this the greatest musical, and we as the audience know that it isn't. And so there are some aspects of its imperfections that I find endearing, but ultimately, the show just didn't work for me. You have multiple layers to this musical. So part of it is him walking you as the audience through his musical, which is basically based off of his own life, but takes place on a fictional planet. At the same time, he is having these interactions with his mom and waiting for a, uh, rejection or acceptance letter from a school that he's applied to. And then about halfway through, they also throw in a talent show. It just becomes too many things when this really could just be a very simple, uh, through line of just pitching this musical. Because it becomes hard to get invested in his story when there's all these different things happening. The other downside is that while the music starts off very Interesting. As the show goes on, all of the songs start to sound the same, which could be intentional, especially because there's a lot of intentional nods to Dear Evan Hansen in this. And if you know Dear Evan Hansen, a lot of those songs do sound the same. But that is a show with stakes, and this is just missing that. And I think that there would be a way to intentionally make something that is imperfect, with that being the the landing pad that this musical ends up at, but it just doesn't quite hit that landing. Totally. I think this is an interesting concept with a great leading performance. So there is some voice over work that isn't quite the best, but ultimately this was middle of the road for me. I think there's a lot to like about it, but there just wasn't enough.
